definitions.meaning: An enclosed place where hurt or affliction is suffered, a prison

quotations.english: they reached their place of exile in hell

quotations.old_english: Hé his maguþegne under hearmlocan hǽlo ábeád
quotations.english: he announced safety to his servant in prison
quotations.citations: Andr. Kmbl. 189; An. 95: 2058; An. 1031: Elen. Kmbl. 1386; El. 695

source_text: hearm-loca, an; m. An enclosed place where hurt or affliction is suffered, a prison :-- Wræcstówe under hearmlocan gefóran they reached their place of exile in hell, Cd. 5; Th. 6, 19; Gen. 91. Hé his maguþegne under hearmlocan hǽlo ábeád he announced safety to his servant in prison, Andr. Kmbl. 189; An. 95: 2058; An. 1031: Elen. Kmbl. 1386; El. 695.
